info.title: AutoReach API
info.description: REST API for the AutoReach career automation and outreach platform. All JSON keys are camelCase and every response uses the standard envelope.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Decision-maker contacts discovered for matched jobs

post.summary: Create an account and its candidate profile
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new session
post.description: Each refresh token is single-use. Presenting a token that was already used revokes every token descended from the same login.

post.summary: Revoke the session the refresh token belongs to

post.description: Accepts up to 500 postings. The whole request is validated first: if any posting is invalid the request is rejected with 422 and `error.details` names each failing field as `jobs[<index>].<field>`. Valid requests are upserted by job hash (company domain + normalised title) and queued for embedding. A posting that is already stored and embedded produces no task.

post.summary: Create an API client for a scraper or integration
post.description: The API key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.
